description: Input validation and error reporting as neutral categories. The tool rejects invalid configurations and impossible requests, reporting a normalised error category rather than completing. Categories covered: the scripts configuration must be an object (not a string/array), the skip configuration must be an object, a custom changelog header must not itself look like a release-section heading, a release with no manifest and tag-fallback disabled has no version source, and a manual release request given without a release-type value is incomplete. A run that completes successfully reports no error. Input describes a run designed to trigger (or not) a specific condition; output reports a single neutral error-category line.
